# scripts/sema_conflicts_baseline.txt — accepted signature conflicts.
#
# Generated by:  python3 scripts/sema_scan.py --mode conflicts --names-only
# Gated by:      scripts/test_sema_signature_conflicts.sh
# Explained in:  docs/adder_signature_conflicts.md
#
# One line per PUBLIC name whose declarations disagree across modules, with
# its classification at the time it was accepted:
#
#   LIVE      the disagreeing declarations ALREADY co-occur in a real link
#             unit. merge_programs keeps one and silently drops the rest, so
#             some caller is compiled against the wrong ABI right now. Live
#             entries are DEBT, not policy — see the doc for each one.
#   LANDMINE  no link unit sees both spellings today. Harmless until someone
#             adds an import, at which point the compiler says nothing. The
#             gate fails if a LANDMINE line ever becomes LIVE.
#
# This list is SHRINK-ONLY by intent: a name not in it fails the build. When
# you unify a signature, delete its line (the gate prints "RESOLVED" for
# baselined names that no longer conflict).
#
# 2026-07-31 — +10 LANDMINE names. The baseline was last regenerated on
# 2026-07-25 (1cc93344); every one of these came in with a file that landed
# AFTER that date, and none is LIVE:
#
#   ctl        lib/web/js/state.ad var vs user/sysirqprobe.ad + wakelat.ad fn
#   cyc_to_ns  kernel/time/clocksource.ad (2 args) vs tests/checkarith/* (3)
#   dig_buf    lib/hamclockcore.ad Array[12] vs user/ed25519_selftest.ad [64]
#   msg_buf    tests/test_ed25519_verify.ad [1 MiB] vs ed25519_selftest [256 K]
#   out        tests/homedir_host.ad [128] vs user/dircolors.ad [16384]
#   prev_btn   lib/hamui.ad int32 vs user/htermsel_evt_host.ad int64
#   put_hex    user/ed25519_selftest.ad (3 args) vs user/umdf_host.ad (1)
#   put_u64    user/inflate_host.ad (fd, v) vs lex_selftest/factor (v)
#   read_exact user/x11/* -> int32 vs user/wakelat_echo.ad -> uint64
#   slen       tests/test_compiler_adjacent_strings.ad -> int64 vs -> uint64
#
# These are the usual single-TU-program collisions on generic names (Adder has
# no module privacy, so every top-level name is public). They went unnoticed
# for six days only because scripts/list_host_gates.sh returned 283 of 645
# gates and this one was never in a sweep. Nothing to unify: no link unit
# imports both spellings of any of them.
